query:
UPDATE list_items i
                  SET "values" = CASE WHEN m.value = 'null'::jsonb THEN i."values" - $2::text
                                      ELSE jsonb_set(i."values", ARRAY[$2::text], m.value) END
                 FROM jsonb_each($3) AS m
                WHERE i.list_id = $1 AND i.id = m.key::uuid
